facts.fact: The DGPF director says one directorate handles both the biometric ID card and civil-status records, with birth and marriage certificates being integrated into a digital database, and an integrated identity and civil-status system as the long-term aim.

DJI.note: No count or share of people enrolled.
Nothing on a number at birth.

facts.fact: The DGPF, through its director, says it issues the biometric national ID card across the territory since 2025 and runs the enrolment centres and mobile biometric teams itself.

DJI.note: Interoperability for verifying the card is only being worked on; no register is stated as keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The DGPF director says the biometric national ID card, with a chip holding the holder's fingerprints, has been issued across the national territory since 2025.
